title: SemCSE: Semantic Contrastive Sentence Embeddings Using LLM-Generated Summaries For Scientific Abstracts
subcategory: LLM-generated summaries as positives for domain (scientific) embeddings
problem: Citation-based supervision (SPECTER-style) does not necessarily reflect semantic similarity of scientific texts.
architecture: Contrastive training that pulls together LLM-generated summaries of the same abstract; new semantic benchmark (title-abstract, abstract-segment and query matching, semantic clustering) plus SciRepEval evaluation.
llm_or_encoder: small sentence-transformer encoder; LLM for summary generation
key_results: Semantic clustering score 0.739 vs 0.730 for MiniLM and 0.721 for NvEmbed.
strengths: State of the art on SciRepEval among models of its size.
Questions citation-based supervision for scientific embeddings.

limitations.text: Reliance on LLM-generated summaries can introduce systemic biases and hallucinated content into the embeddings.
Interpretability of the embeddings remains a challenge.
